ns2:section.sectionText: INVESTMENT BANKING. Restricted to junior & senior finance majors until Monday, April 25, when it will open to the College. This course provides a broad overview of the financial services industry with a focus on investment banking. In particular, investment bankers play a role in restructuring industry, financing governments, and facilitating saving and investment. Topics will include the functions performed by investment banks and the manner in which these activities are carried out. Among those functions are the concepts of origination, syndication, and distribution of security issues.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Accountancy or Economics or Finance or Business Administration major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing. Not intended for BALAS:Economics -UIUC.
